[[Image:Thorn Hill.jpg|thumb|Thorn Hill]]
'''Thorn Hill''' is a sizable hill nestled on the north face of a mountain top between the [[Crossroads]] and [[Durotar]]. It is populated by a large number of [[Quilboar]] who have recently been raiding [[Horde]] caravans in the region, and thus have attracted the ire of the local security forces. Thorn Hill is led by the cunning quilboar raider named [[Kreenig Snarlsnout]].
